From Adriatic walls to Aegean isles and the Turquoise Coast, the Mediterranean reveals millennia of history. Venetian façades, Byzantine relics and Greco-Roman ruins meet whitewashed villages and quiet harbours, as Amangati navigates storied coastlines.
Amangati luxury motor yacht illuminated at sea in the evening
A New Era in Maritime Adventure
Where time extends and each destination reveals a lesser-told story. Setting sail from Spring 2027.

For over 35 years, Aman has created tranquil sanctuaries defined by design, setting and service. Aman at Sea’s inaugural yacht, Amangati, carries this legacy to the sea – charting a new course through the world’s most storied coastlines. Designed by Sinot Yacht Architecture & Design, Amangati presents a matchless experience on the water across nine decks. Comprising just 47 suites, each with private terrace, generosity of space abounds. Culinary experiences on board, presented across eight bar and dining venues, are guided by Aman’s philosophy of simplicity and balance. At its pinnacle, the imposing Aman Spa unfolds, remarkable in scope and space, with an open-air serenity garden and private treatment suites offering moments of quiet retreat – a reflection of the peaceful motion that gives Amangati its name.

Inviting stillness and ease, suite design blurs the boundary between interior space and sea with ceilings up to 2.5 metres (8.2 feet), full-height windows and private terraces. Each suite is complete with generous bathrooms and intuitive technology. A dedicated Suite Host ensures every need is attended to with discreet presence.
The Amangati luxury motor yacht's Suite Stateroom with a private terrace, deep-soaking whirlpool bath, and expansive ocean views.
An expansive and refined sanctuary with a private spa and sweeping terraces ideal for al fresco dining, Amangati’s signature suite spans 354 square metres (3,810 square feet).

Spacious suites occupy 102 square metres (1,098 square feet) with welcoming foyer and separate living area opening to bow-facing views and an expansive terrace extending the space outdoors.

From Alira’s sun-kissed Mediterranean flavours to the elemental refinement of Aman Grill and the quiet theatre of Japanese teppanyaki at Hiori, eight distinctive dining and lounge venues invite exploration through artistry and atmosphere. Evenings drift toward the Cigar Lounge and The Jazz Club, where craft cocktails and music flow with ease.

Infused with the spirit of the ocean, this relaxed, open-air restaurant embraces the essence of Mediterranean cuisine. From sun-drenched Greek islands to the lemon groves of Amalfi and the lavender fields of Provence. The restaurant celebrates seasonality and coastal elegance, with daily dishes inspired by the flavours and traditions of each destination Amangati explores.
Circular ocean-view dining at Alira aboard the Amangati yacht during a luxury Mediterranean yacht voyage
A dark timber teppanyaki counter with sleek stools and glowing shoji-style lamps aboard the 'Aman at Sea' luxury yacht cruise.

Hiori is where culinary mastery becomes quiet ritual. Derived from the Japanese words for heat and craft, the atmosphere is energetic yet intimate as the chef curates an elemental teppanyaki experience with precise technique and vivid movement. Shaped by the flavours of the season, each dish draws upon time-honoured traditions. The chef’s immersive culinary interplay creates personal moments with guests and gives the experience its warmth. Artisanal Japanese sakes, rare whiskies and contemplative teas carry the evening through to its satiating close.
A minimalist table, chairs and tea, overlooking a calm, twilight sea at the fine dining restaurant aboard the Amangati yacht.

Rooted in washoku, the Japanese culinary tradition honoured by UNESCO, Akari illuminates each season through ingredients sourced at their peak, prepared with the exacting discipline of age-old technique. Japanese for ‘light’, the name speaks to what the kitchen pursues: clarity, harmony, the natural world at its finest. The menu moves between classic dishes and a signature omakase experience, each rooted in seasonality and deliberate craft. Omotenashi — wholehearted, anticipatory service — flows effortlessly through every moment.

An homage to the elemental art of cooking by fire, Aman Grill celebrates the traditions of open-flame cooking. Prime aged meats, whole fish and fresh, seasonal vegetables are honoured with artistic plating and served with precision. Presented as an arc of intimate nooks and thoughtful table settings, Aman Grill is rooted in classical techniques, with tableside rituals and sommelier-led wine pairings. Next door, The Bar at Aman Grill is an intimate space for smoke-forward cocktails and barrel-aged whiskies, aperitifs and nightcaps.
